text:
Nina Park: hey everyone, thrilled to join Redwood Inference as a product designer! :wave: Im in PDX (PST) and my hobbies are plant rescue, indie game jams, and karaoke. remote first today but hoping to swing by SF in a few months. where do folks usually post intro pics?
Juno: welcome Nina!! we usually post in this thread or the #random channel for pets/plants. also theres a plant-swaps channel if you want cuttings. :seedling:
People Ops Bot: @Nina Park please fill the New Hire Shipping form: https://redwood.example.com/ship-form for swag delivery. reply here if you want no physical swag. :package:
Avery: hi Nina, welcome! karaoke?? whats your go-to song? :microphone:
Nina Park: depends on mood but Im a sucker for 90s alt — "No Rain" or "Linger" are reliable.
Sam: nice, welcome! also quick heads up: we do monthly "design show & tell" where new folks can demo a little project. sign-ups posted in #design.
DevEx: onboarding tips: check the pinned checklist in #new-hires and make sure to set up 2FA. if anything's missing ping me.
Maya Chen: welcome Nina!! love plant rescue people. bring before/after pics when you get comfy. :herb:
Rafael: welcome aboard. FYI SF office hosts a karaoke night with terrible song choices and great snacks. youll fit right in.
Nina Park: awesome, karaoke long-term plan: duet with Rafael on something delightfully bad. also Ill fill the shipping form now.
People Ops Bot: Shipping form received from @Nina Park. Estimated swag delivery: 7-10 business days.
Juno: PSA: monthly virtual coffee pairing sheet for new hires in the Drive. Nina, if you drop your time zone well match folks.
Nina Park: PST afternoons work best for me (1-4pm). happy to be paired.
Avery: welcome again! also any snack allergies we should know about for in-person events?
Nina Park: no allergies, just a fervent dislike of cilantro. :)
Sam: cilantro hill of shame noted. :grimacing:
DevEx: quick follow: confirm you joined #design, #general, #new-hires, and #random and that you completed identity verification.
Nina Park: joined channels confirmed, identity verification submitted, will finish 2FA today. thanks for the warm welcome everyone! :smile:
Rafael: welcome Nina. looking forward to terrible karaoke and excellent design collabs. :guitar_hero:
